from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=3,
            worker_prompts=["Decrypt the target ciphertext using the hint pair. Propose one full uppercase plaintext candidate with exact target-ciphertext length. In later rounds, inspect peers for dropped/extra/shifted letters and revise only if needed.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nPeer proposals:\n{all_proposals}", "Decrypt the target ciphertext using the hint pair. Propose one full uppercase plaintext candidate with exact target-ciphertext length. In later rounds, inspect peers for dropped/extra/shifted letters and revise only if needed.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nPeer proposals:\n{all_proposals}", "Decrypt the target ciphertext using the hint pair. Propose one full uppercase plaintext candidate with exact target-ciphertext length. In later rounds, inspect peers for dropped/extra/shifted letters and revise only if needed.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nPeer proposals:\n{all_proposals}"],
            aggregator_prompt="Select the best decryption from the debated proposals. Prefer the candidate that preserves the full target ciphertext length exactly and resolves truncation, insertion, or one-position shift errors. Output only the plaintext candidate in uppercase.\nProblem:\n{problem}\nProposals:\n{all_proposals}", n_rounds=2)
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_rounds=1, prompts=[prompt_custom.DECRYPT_REPAIR_FROM_HINT, prompt_custom.DECRYPT_FINAL_CODEBLOCK_ONLY])
        final = await seq(f"Problem:\n{problem}\nDraft plaintext candidate:\n{draft['response']}")
        return final['response'], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
